# Embedded Emissions: CN 7207 11 90, China

**Total embedded emissions: 49,710.00 tCO2e**

## Inputs

| Required input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | In table ✓ |
| (b) Country of production | China | Listed for this CN code ✓ |
| (c) Quantity | 15,000 tonnes | Provided ✓ |

I have read "Chinese semi-finished steel" as meaning the steel was produced in China. If China is only the country of dispatch or origin and production happened elsewhere, a different default value would apply.

## Factor

The default SEE for (7207 11 90, China) is **3.314 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 3.314 tCO2e/t × 15,000 t
= **49,710.00 tCO2e**
